caption: Termoli old town and Swabian Castle, Termoli
composition: Adriatic promontory castle and seafront walls · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint looks along the Adriatic coast at dawn, where the Swabian Castle crowns the rocky promontory center-frame above the clustered old town. Pale stone houses climb to the right along the lit seafront wall, while open sea fills the left under a pink-and-blue streaked sky. At 06:50 the town's windows still glow warm against the first daylight on the cliffs.
